question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Lanky
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Plump)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lanky"** refers to someone who is tall, thin, and often awkward in movement or appearance. (दुबला-पतला और लंबा)

 
 
• **Example:** The lanky boy struggled to fit into the small chair during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Plump"** is the antonym of "Lanky" and refers to someone or something that is slightly fat or rounded in shape, indicating a fuller appearance. (गोलमटोल)
 
 
• **Example:** The plump cat lay lazily on the couch, basking in the sunlight.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"Lanky"** is **"Plump"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Plump)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rare** (दुर्लभ): Something uncommon, unusual, or unique.

 
 
• **Example:** It is rare to find such a talented artist in this small town.
 
 
 
• **Rectangular** (आयताकार): Having the shape of a rectangle, with four right angles.
 
 
• **Example:** The rectangular table was perfect for the dining room.
 
 
 
• **Congenital** (जन्मजात): Referring to a condition or trait that is present from birth.
 
 
• **Example:** The child was diagnosed with a congenital heart defect.

योग्य उत्तर आहे: **पर्याय 1 (Plump)**.
